visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with light brown hair and bangs, wearing a white oversized shirt over a white top and blue denim jeans, sits on the floor leaning against a wall. She is intently reading a book titled 'Body Language'. Behind her, large black-and-white posters feature a shirtless muscular man wearing a necktie. (2) The scene cuts to the woman sitting in an audience at a dark indoor event. A muscular, shirtless man with a gold chain and a necktie pulls on a patterned scarf wrapped around the woman's neck. She laughs excitedly while looking up at him. (3) The camera shows a close-up of a page in the book discussing 'The Standing Power Pose'. It then cuts back to the woman sitting next to a female friend in the dark venue, both still looking at the book. (4) The woman is then seen hugging the waist of a shirtless male performer from behind as he stands in front of her. She is laughing joyfully. Three question marks appear as a text overlay.
